upstream.note: Structured incident metadata + factual summaries; every row deep-links the original.

incidents.title: Cantone di Basilea: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Hackers breached the Cantone di Basilea’s IT systems and stole about 97,000 work‑permit records of cross‑border workers. The cantonal administration confirmed the breach and reported the incident to federal authorities. Switzerland.

incidents.title: US-Finanzministerium: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Unauthorized actors accessed part of the US Treasury Department’s IT systems, prompting the agency to take services offline. The Treasury confirmed the cyberattack and is working on remediation. United States.

incidents.title: liverpool.ac.uk: Claimed by Scarlettgroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: Scarlettgroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Scarlettgroup group listed liverpool.ac.uk on its leak site. The organisation has not confirmed an attack, so treat this as a claim. United Kingdom.

incidents.title: U.S. Treasury Department: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Unauthorized actors accessed part of the U.S. Treasury Department’s IT systems, leading to the temporary shutdown of several reporting services. The Treasury and FinCEN have confirmed the cyberattack and extended reporting deadlines. United States.

incidents.title: ESAGAMES: Confirmed DDoS attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. ESAGAMES was hit by a multi‑terabit DDoS campaign targeting one of its customers. The company confirmed the attack reached over 5 Tbps and that the customer remained online after mitigation. Germany.

incidents.title: Korea Investment Savings Bank: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. A hacking incident at Korea Investment Savings Bank leaked personal information of about 86,000 customers. The bank confirmed the breach and reported that no financial transaction data was compromised. South Korea.

incidents.title: Planet IC: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. An unauthorized access to the servers of the municipal IT service provider Planet IC in Schwerin was detected over the weekend. Planet IC and the energy supplier WEMAG have confirmed the incident but have not disclosed how many customer records were affected. Schwerin, Germany.

incidents.title: 1Password: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. A hacker compromised a 1Password employee’s GitHub account, used it to inject malicious code into internal services and steal client data. 1Password confirmed the breach but said password vaults and encryption keys were not compromised. Canada.

incidents.title: Ochsner Sport: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Ochsner Sport reported that hackers accessed customer data including names, addresses, invoices, and payment methods, while passwords and account data were untouched. The company contained the incident and filed a criminal complaint. Zürich, Switzerland.

incidents.title: ENEOS: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. ENEOS detected unauthorized access to its official app system and suspended app services from around 16:00 on November 25. Whether customer information leaked and the scope of impact were under investigation. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Sapporo Drug Store: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Sapporo Drug Store (Satudora) reported that 229,026 LINE account records were exposed after its contractor CyberAgent mistakenly placed a file containing customer personal information in a publicly accessible cloud storage area. Sapporo, Japan.

incidents.title: EISYS: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. EISYS, operator of the Ci-en creator platform, suffered unauthorized access with possible leakage of creator transaction personal data. All functions and services were unavailable from November 24 to November 25. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Tokyo Metropolitan Government: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. The Tokyo Metropolitan Government reported that a Singapore dispatch programme operator, NUSX, set recipients in the CC field instead of BCC, exposing participants' names and email addresses. The incident was disclosed on November 25. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Pal System: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Pal System reported that more than 1,997,000 customer records leaked through unauthorized access to the external KARTE service used in its ordering site and app. The incident was disclosed on November 25. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Flight Centre Travel Group: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Flight Centre Travel Group confirmed an investigation into unauthorized activity within a third-party booking system that potentially exposed customer records across multiple leisure brands in Australia. Shares fell 2% in early trade. Brisbane, Australia.

incidents.title: Proliance Surgeons: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Class-action investigation announced regarding breach discovered September 2 and announced November 6. Exposed data includes names, DOB, medical record numbers and SSNs for some. Seattle, United States.

incidents.title: Mediadu: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Mediadu reported unauthorized access affecting the Comic C'MoA partner content delivery and sales service. Japan.

incidents.title: Kyoei Steel: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Kyoei Steel reported unauthorized access to the internal network and shared file server of its US subsidiary, Vinton Steel LLC. Japan.

incidents.title: Satsudora: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Satsudora reported a personal-data leak of 220,000 records caused by a contractor's misconfiguration. Japan.

incidents.title: Valley Family Health Care: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Valley Family Health Care, Inc. reported a data breach to the California Attorney General with names exposed. Notification letters were sent via IDX to affected individuals. Los Angeles, United States.

incidents.title: Telecare Health: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Telecare Health notified 19,922 Washington residents of a data breach where names were exposed. Letters were sent via IDX to inform affected individuals. Seattle, United States.

incidents.title: Phreesia: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Phreesia, Inc. disclosed a vendor breach linked to the Salesloft Drift supply-chain incident, affecting 100,000 people with SSNs and medical data exposed. Letters were sent via Kroll. Denver, United States.

incidents.title: Manchester Public Schools: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. A data breach was discovered on a Board of Education server after a TikTok video showed unauthorized access. Officials confirmed the breach and have disconnected the server while the investigation continues. Manchester, United States.

incidents.title: Real Time Data Services Pvt: Claimed by TheGentlemen, not confirmed
incidents.description: TheGentlemen claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. TheGentlemen ransomware group claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Real Time Data Services Pvt Ltd, affecting their cloud hosting and telephony services. The incident was reported on November 25. Gurugram, India.

incidents.title: Hospital Sagrada Familia: Claimed by TheGentlemen, not confirmed
incidents.description: TheGentlemen claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. TheGentlemen ransomware group claimed responsibility for a cyberattack on Hospital Sagrada Familia, a key healthcare provider in Colombia. The group threatened to leak sensitive data if demands were not met. Medellín, Colombia.

incidents.title: Company #273: Claimed by N0n, not confirmed

The N0n ransomware group published a listing for Company #273, described as a broadcast television organization in the United States. The listing was marked '[PENDING EXPOSURE]' and dated November 25. United States.

The listing was marked '[PENDING EXPOSURE]' and dated November 25, providing no details about the alleged incident. Italy.

incidents.description: N0n claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The N0n ransomware group published a listing for Company #276, a real estate entity in the United States. The listing was marked '[PENDING EXPOSURE]' and dated November 25, providing no details about the alleged incident. United States.

incidents.description: N0n claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The N0n ransomware group published a listing for Company #269, an Indonesia-based online gaming deposit and settlement business. The listing was marked '[PENDING EXPOSURE]' and dated November 25, providing no details about the alleged incident. Indonesia.

incidents.title: Company #272: Claimed by N0n, not confirmed
incidents.description: N0n claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The N0n ransomware group published a listing for Company #272, a US law library and legal research services provider. The listing was marked '[PENDING EXPOSURE]' and dated November 25, providing no details about the alleged incident. United States.

incidents.title: Honigman LLP: Claimed by SilentRansomGroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: SilentRansomGroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. SilentRansomGroup claims data theft from the US law firm. The listing appeared on the group's leak site on November 25. United States.

incidents.title: Camsons Pty: Claimed on a leak site, not confirmed
incidents.description: Claimed on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Spacebears ransomware group listed Camsons Pty Ltd, a transport and logistics company, on its data leak site. Sydney, Australia.

incidents.title: Markt Buttenheim: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 25 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. The German municipality of Markt Buttenheim reported an IT security incident that left the town hall's IT infrastructure largely unavailable. The town published a notice about the outage. Germany.

incidents.title: Vincci Hotels: Claimed by Black X, not confirmed
incidents.description: Black X claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 25 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group Black X claimed Spanish hotel group Vincci Hotels as a victim on its leak site. The claim was not confirmed by the company. Spain.

incidents.title: Vanderbilt University: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 25 Nov 2026. Vanderbilt University experienced a cyberattack that disrupted Brightspace, Outlook, OneDrive and other services. The university confirmed the attack on Nov. 9 and is working to restore affected systems. Nashville, United States.

incidents.title: sunnybrook.ca: Claimed by Scarlettgroup, not confirmed
incidents.description: Scarlettgroup claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The Scarlettgroup group listed sunnybrook.ca on its leak site. The organisation has not confirmed an attack, so treat this as a claim. Canada.

incidents.title: MiTAC Digital Technology: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 24 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Taiwanese technology company MiTAC Digital Technology reported that parts of its IT systems were affected by an external cyberattack. The company said there was no initial material operational or financial impact. Taoyuan, Taiwan.

incidents.title: Elmet Group: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Elmet Group Co. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on 2026-11-24 that discusses a cybersecurity incident. Read the filing for scope and impact. Portland, United States.

incidents.title: London Gatwick Airport: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. London Gatwick Airport suffered unauthorized access to a third-party drop-off payment system, exposing contact and vehicle information and partial card details in isolated cases. The airport is located in Crawley, West Sussex. London, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: FinCEN: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. FinCEN confirmed that unauthorized access was detected in a portion of its computer systems, prompting the agency to take some systems offline as a precaution. The breach has not been linked to any specific hacker group and no sensitive financial records have been confirmed stolen. Washington, United States.

incidents.title: Septeo IT Solutions: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Septeo IT Solutions confirmed that an unauthorized individual accessed its internal customer relationship management platform on 22 November 2026 and extracted client contact, billing and support ticket data. The company stated that its software and services remain unaffected and that the breach has been contained. Lattes, France.

incidents.title: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN): Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. FinCEN disclosed it is investigating a cybersecurity incident resulting in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems. Some systems were taken offline as a precaution. Washington, United States.

incidents.title: Todoist / Doist: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Todoist disclosed that an attacker used stolen credentials to download account records for about 6% of users, including emails and salted password hashes. The notice was published on November 24. San Francisco, United States.

incidents.title: Deichmann SE: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Deichmann SE reported unauthorized access to selected customer data from its online shop, potentially exposing names, addresses, invoices, email addresses, telephone numbers, and payment methods. Passwords and card numbers were not affected. Köln, Germany.

incidents.title: West Norfolk Council: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. West Norfolk Council was targeted by a cyber attack on Monday night, which was detected and contained by its security monitoring systems. The council confirmed that no data was accessed and an investigation has been launched. King's Lynn, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: ODNI: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. The Office of the Director of National Intelligence shared an unclassified system for analysing public information that was compromised in a cyber incident. Classified material remained secure during the intrusion. McLean, United States.

incidents.title: NGA: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency was named as affected in the same intrusion that hit the CIA and ODNI. The agency's systems were part of the breach affecting unclassified data. Springfield, United States.

incidents.title: Turnitin: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Turnitin detected unauthorized activity involving certain customer-facing systems and activated its incident response plan. Law enforcement and cyber regulators have been notified regarding the security event. Oakland, United States.

incidents.title: Colla Health: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Colla Health notified the California Attorney General of a data security incident involving a third-party application exploiting a Metabase vulnerability. Over 336,400 individuals were affected, with patient data exfiltrated. Houston, United States.
